cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Be There for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to show up, help, or stay involved as proof that the connection still matters.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come paint Dad's kitchen with me. I'll handle the cutting-in; since he died, I barely see you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll pay someone. I can't paint over his height marks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We don't paint the marks. Low-tack tape around them, then brush away from the edge. Come hold the tape straight for me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll probably just sit on the floor and cry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll put the dust sheet down before you sit. No paint tins in the way. Just come, please; I want you there, not a replacement painter.

reason: Make practical preservation and preparation expertise the way A adapts the invitation, with B grief changing the task into presence rather than prompting a card summary.
